findings.title: Retained live terminal retries and completion do not re-resolve installed identity
findings.trigger: Source or engine bytes drift after a failed terminal/CFG/ACK attempt, or after stage done before completion consumption.
findings.evidence: ContinueFlow resolves ContentIdentity only when constructing the coordinator. retry, including done return, and consume_live_completion only validate the frozen identity through Profiles structure/context and Intent.capture; they do not read current installed bytes.
findings.impact: A retained live operation can finish progress, ACK and grant completion against stale source identity.
findings.required_change: Re-resolve fixed actual ContentIdentity before every retained retry and before consuming completion, comparing the complete actual identity to the immutable initial identity; drift must remain rejected.

findings.title: Deferred preference snapshot is stranded when progress/startup gate is closed
findings.trigger: save_prefs is queued during startup or a pending campaign terminal; the callback runs while Gate is closed.
findings.evidence: _save_prefs_deferred sets _prefs_deferred=false then returns while retaining _prefs_requested. Startup completion and progress_committed do not queue the retained request again.
findings.impact: Normal requested preferences may never persist unless the user performs another preference save.
findings.required_change: Wake retained preferences after the actual gate opens and after successful progress closure, without duplicate callbacks and without writing in physics.

findings.title: A failed cloud CFG writer has no reachable live retry path
findings.trigger: An ordinary cloud application enters CFG writer and an I/O step fails while the original writer remains busy.
findings.evidence: Campaign retains the writer, but apply_cloud_progress only returns false; Flow.note_config_failure is called only from deferred preferences. SteamCloud._process/_attach/_pull/_flush all return when Campaign.persistence_busy, so they cannot drive the retained writer.
findings.impact: Background synchronization and launch remain blocked in-process with no visible original-object cloud retry action.
findings.required_change: Expose a failure/retry path for the actual root SteamCloud original proposal and original Campaign writer; do not recreate or silently replace the failed operation.

findings.title: Legitimate A-to-B cloud transition is rejected by retained CFG retry ownership check
findings.trigger: During a legitimate account A to B transition, CFG replacement fails before Campaign._load publishes B.
findings.evidence: Cloud permits original_owner A and target_owner B, and keeps Campaign.cloud_owner A until commit. retry_persistence requires cloud_owner == _cfg_writer_scope.target_owner B before retry_write.
findings.impact: The exact retained authorized cloud transaction cannot recover even if its storage failure is repaired.
findings.required_change: Bind the original shared-profile owner, target owner, actual root Cloud identity/account and original binding/proposal; authorize that frozen transition without relabeling old data or requiring prematurely published target owner.

findings.title: Quit and local apply can write scoped cloud mirrors while persistence gate is closed
findings.trigger: App closes with cloud_ready/dirty while startup/progress/prefs persistence is pending, or apply_payload is invoked with from_cloud=false during pending persistence.
findings.evidence: _exit_tree calls _remember_local without gate; _remember_local and _store_mirror lack gate/pending checks. apply_payload(false) also directly calls _store_mirror. Guarding _process/_flush does not guard these actual writes.
findings.impact: A new mirrored profile can be persisted from unconfirmed in-memory state while the campaign source/proposal remains blocked.
findings.required_change: Enforce Gate and pending checks at the actual mirror write path, including quit and local apply, while preserving authorized frozen cloud retry as a separate validated path.

findings.title: Owned pre-proposal lock failures with empty active state cannot be retried or released
findings.trigger: After acquire, a read/scope refusal occurs before _active building is initialized and releasing the own lock also has a transient I/O failure; acquire itself may fail after creating writing.
findings.evidence: busy remains true from _locked/_lock_created, but preparation_pending requires a nonempty building _active; retry_write rejects empty _active and abort_unprepared also rejects it. No original-object release retry is reachable.
findings.impact: The retained writer blocks all subsequent writes and launch in-process with CFG_FROZEN_PROPOSAL_REQUIRED even after safe storage repair.
findings.required_change: Represent and retain a pre-proposal owned release state with exact nonce/head and no frozen/staged/pending proposal. Retry only verification and removal of the exact own lock; do not guess ownership or discard malformed/partially written metadata.

findings.title: Startup discards the retained non-progress CFG recovery object on failure
findings.trigger: Startup recovers a pending prefs/cloud CFG; recover_pending enters retry_write, acquires a current-process lock and fails later.
findings.evidence: cfg is a local ConfigTransaction.new variable. On failure _startup_failed returns without retaining it. retry_startup creates a different object; _head then inspects the still-live original process lock and refuses WRITER_ALIVE. The progress coordinator path does retain objects.
findings.impact: The startup Retry action cannot repair non-progress CFG recovery in the same process.
findings.required_change: Retain the startup CFG object and immutable operation/source/owner scope. After fresh actual identity/owner checks, resume that original object; never hand its live lock to a recreated writer.

findings.title: CFG pending metadata reports zero-generation writing and recovering residue as no pending operation
findings.trigger: The first CFG writer has created writing/owner.json but no prepared record, or recovering residue exists without writing on an applied/zero head.
findings.evidence: pending_status returns pending=false for head.revision==0 regardless of writing; the nonzero expression checks writing but omits recovering. It does not inspect actual PID/lock metadata on these omitted states. Startup final checks therefore may open Gate while that residue or an actual other writer remains.
findings.impact: Startup can report confirmed/unblocked despite unvalidated ownership or an active/pending CFG writer.
findings.required_change: Read-only classify all writing/recovering/receipt.pending states and inspect exact metadata/PID before declaring none pending. Zero-generation/unknown proposal residue must fail closed; any recovery must be separately scoped and verified.

Classic lifecycle/store and all 13 production baselines remain byte-identical.
Caller preload cycles are broken through fixed ResourceLoader script paths; all 77 literal scripts are recorded and exact-pinned.
